method: Read complete English source and all kind/ID/name/description contexts for each reviewed index; manually translate and self-review. Expert fields explicitly reread before exact reuse. No unread automatic fill or external translation service.

references.basis: Wiki names table Nintendo label; not Punk Girl/坏女孩. Only outfit display label changed.
Catalog ID emeraldSPE supplies Pokémon Adventures context; Wiki explicitly Emerald=米拉特. Identity is contextual interpretation, not a claim the outfit is official licensed costume.
Trainer class name; preserve dress description, add no supernatural ability.

Exact project usage in Data/localization/dex-proofread/b.json source As part of the Indigo Ice Beams...; Ice Beam=冰冻光束 in project move category. Fictional community team, not claimed official sports franchise.
Trainer class, not military veteran or a named character.
Official simplified Chinese product page confirms mask name. Use only name; retain author Zoroark/fable description and do not add Hisui, shiny colors, distribution or movie plot.
Pokémon Gym Leader in fake-eyebrow/moustache context; no battle/story facts added.
Established hat-style noun, not a literal10-gallon capacity. Numeric surface intentionally translated by idiomatic garment meaning; rootin tootin rendered豪迈十足.
Brock English frying/drying pan wordplay; catalog ID brockpan and explicit rain-off-head description establish intended use. Contextual creative Chinese title, not an official Chinese item claim.

boundaries: Only exact source-to-display-text output; original IDs/catalog/images/player custom names untouched.
197 are independent source strings, not 197 distinct outfit records.
All assigned0–196 source strings manually translated/reviewed and saved; no claim about the other half handled by another agent.

interpretations.basis: Translate displayed Hooded as 连帽款; internal hooddown/hoodup IDs are preserved and not treated as text to repair.
Marshweater combines Marshtomp and sweater; 沼跃鱼毛衣 preserves species and garment without an unnatural transliteration.
Slow Suit uses 呆呆套装 to retain the relaxed Slow-family association; do not introduce a specific Slowpoke/Slowbro identity absent from display source.
Splicer in this fusion game is interpreted as 融合师 for an outfit title; creative context translation, not an official profession claim.

Yellow Qipao kept as黄色旗袍 because description explicitly denotes color; Emerald Cap is Brendan RSE version-themed绿宝石帽, distinct from Emerald Gear IDemeraldSPE=米拉特. Do not use a global Emerald translation.

Partner Cap has Ash internal ID but displayed name is搭档帽; preserve original L logo as one Latin letter, not untranslated dialogue, and do not replace caption with a different official game clothing item.
Original with a white . omits the object. Translate only white accent and Breeder use; do not invent a PokéBall or stripe absent from source. Source record unchanged.
Species names taken from current categorized project/PokeAPI glossary; costume shapes/descriptions retain author wording, not species abilities.
